factor_definitions.current_output: dense versus sparse using the old common support
factor_definitions.future_support: fresh exact map versus held map; not a cheap-selector factor

dense_full_fix51994.interpretation: Each span label is separate. GPU activity categories are exclusive assignments but simultaneous kernels may overlap; do not sum category unions into request time. Gaps are not proof of host idle.
dense_full_fix51994.overall_denominator: audited decoder GLOBAL Q128/KV64 full support plus LOCAL window-intersecting rectangles; not CUDA CTA counts

dynamic.interpretation: Each span label is separate. GPU activity categories are exclusive assignments but simultaneous kernels may overlap; do not sum category unions into request time. Gaps are not proof of host idle.
dynamic.overall_denominator: audited decoder GLOBAL Q128/KV64 full support plus LOCAL window-intersecting rectangles; not CUDA CTA counts

fixed16.interpretation: Each span label is separate. GPU activity categories are exclusive assignments but simultaneous kernels may overlap; do not sum category unions into request time. Gaps are not proof of host idle.
fixed16.overall_denominator: audited decoder GLOBAL Q128/KV64 full support plus LOCAL window-intersecting rectangles; not CUDA CTA counts

critical_path_headroom.reason: Inclusive CUDA spans and exclusive activity categories do not identify removable request-critical-path time or overlap with unaffected work.

allkept_fa4_minus_dynamic.interpretation: Matched input/seed/repetition; dynamic/fixed16 share an engine, substrate controls may use separate engines. Request-level descriptive comparison; runtime variation remains visible.

dense_full_fix51994_minus_dynamic.interpretation: Matched input/seed/repetition; dynamic/fixed16 share an engine, substrate controls may use separate engines. Request-level descriptive comparison; runtime variation remains visible.

dense_piecewise_minus_dynamic.interpretation: Matched input/seed/repetition; dynamic/fixed16 share an engine, substrate controls may use separate engines. Request-level descriptive comparison; runtime variation remains visible.

fixed16_minus_dynamic.interpretation: Matched input/seed/repetition; dynamic/fixed16 share an engine, substrate controls may use separate engines. Request-level descriptive comparison; runtime variation remains visible.

headroom.scope: selected batch-one headroom diagnostic; clean timing and audited work remain separate
headroom.source_interpretation: Referenced clean leaves retain their original protocol and source; successor profiling is a separate execution source. Compare native trajectories before cost transfer.
warnings: No population accuracy, noninferiority, or larger-batch claim follows from this selected cohort.
A refresh-span/request ratio is a descriptive audited-time proxy, not a rigorous speedup bound.
Do not add GLOBAL parent spans to discovery, buffer, or sparse-consumer child spans.

pairing_gate.note: All four factorial full-state prefix signatures must agree; control verification is separate and downstream divergence is not an exclusion rule.
